'''Durquist''' was a [[Conjeni/Legends|Conjeni]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who was associated with three other smugglers: [[Bruce Mercy]], [[Morph]], and [[Ptak-Sok]].

==Equipment==
Durquist carried a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]], [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], and two [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], and always wore a [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Fedora/Legends|fedora]].<ref name="TH" />
